request_evidence: Request for Proposals: Website Redesign & Ecosystem Development

Achievement First is seeking an experienced digital agency to architect and build a unified, scalable digital ecosystem. The solution will comprise a main network website, regional hubs, and 41 distinct school-specific websites under a central governance model.

Please direct all inquiries regarding this RFP to the contact above by October 19, 2026. Written responses to all vendor queries will be distributed by October 23, 2026. Proposals must remain valid for at least 90 days following submission.

request_evidence: The Centerville-Washington Park District (CWPD) is issuing this Request for Proposals (RFP) for the redesign and redevelopment of cwpd.org. CWPD seeks a website that improves customer experience, makes it easier for residents to discover parks, programs and events and provides a flexible, intuitive content management system that can be maintained by non-technical staff.

CWPD is seeking a partner that can provide strategy, information architecture, user experience design, visual design, development, accessibility testing, training, launch support and ongoing maintenance.
qualification_evidence: Mandatory accessibility compliance: WCAG 2.1 Level AA by April 2028
